name: Curiosity Station (Sol 4000)
description: Baseline deployment station on lower Mount Sharp. Hab and communication link.

name: Boxwork Ridge Site Alpha
description: Primary EVA objective. High concentration of cemented polygonal mineral fractures.

name: Sulfate Stratigraphy Bench
description: Secondary science site. Stepped mineral benches indicating ancient climatic drying.

name: Glen Torridon Clay Haven
description: Ancient lacustrine lakebed deposits with smectite clay phyllosilicates.

name: Gediz Vallis Channel Outlook
description: Steep debris-flow channel cutting through upper sulfate layers. High slope hazard.
